title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - DC-3401A
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: DC-3401A (CATALYST REDUCTION REACTOR).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-3401, Title: Catalyst Reduction System – DC-3401A.
Area: 3400 – Catalyst Preparation, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-3400-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- TSHH-3401: Bed temperature HIGH-HIGH (Temperature Switch) [Setpoint: > 230 degC]. Function: Trip initiator T1 → SEQ-3401. Location: Reactor bed. Interlock: SEQ-3401 T1
- TE-3401: Multipoint Thermocouple (8 points) (Temperature Element). Function: Bed temperature profile monitoring. Location: Reactor bed. Interlock: SEQ-3401 P3
- PSHH-3404: Reactor pressure HIGH-HIGH (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: > 5 barg]. Function: Trip initiator T2 → SEQ-3401. Location: Reactor vent line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 T2
- PI-3404: Reactor Pressure Indicator (Pressure Indicator). Function: Local pressure indication. Location: Reactor vent line. Interlock: —
- AI-3401: Outlet O2 Analyzer (Analyzer) [Setpoint: > 100 ppm]. Function: Trip initiator T3 & Permissive P1. Location: Reactor outlet line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 T3 / P1
- FSLL-17343: Nitrogen carrier flow LOW-LOW (Flow Switch) [Setpoint: < 150 kg/h]. Function: Trip initiator T4 → SEQ-3401. Location: N2 carrier line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 T4
- FT-17343: Nitrogen carrier Flow Transmitter (Flow Transmitter). Function: Flow measurement & Permissive P2. Location: N2 carrier line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 P2
- FI-17343: Nitrogen carrier Flow Indicator (Flow Indicator (DCS)). Function: Flow indication on DCS. Location: N2 carrier line. Interlock: —
- EHT-3401: Heater element over-temperature (Temp Switch (Skin)) [Setpoint: > 260 degC]. Function: Trip initiator T5 → SEQ-3401. Location: In-Line Heater EA-3401. Interlock: SEQ-3401 T5
- HS-3401: Emergency Stop Hand Switch (Hand Switch) [Setpoint: Manual —]. Function: Trip initiator T6 (Manual ESD). Location: Local panel. Interlock: SEQ-3401 T6
- TIC-17343: Heater Outlet Temp Controller (Temp Controller) [Setpoint: 180-210 degC]. Function: Control heater EA-3401. Location: Heater outlet. Interlock: —
- FV-17343: N2 Carrier Flow Control Valve (Control Valve) [Setpoint: MAINTAIN —]. Function: EFF-4: Maintain/Increase N2 on trip. Location: N2 carrier line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 EFF-4
- FV-3403: H2 Injection Flow Control Valve (Control Valve) [Setpoint: CLOSED —]. Function: EFF-2: Close H2 on trip. Location: H2 injection line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 EFF-2
- FT-3403: H2 Injection Flow Transmitter (Flow Transmitter). Function: Flow measurement for H2. Location: H2 injection line. Interlock: —
- FI-3403: H2 Injection Flow Indicator (Flow Indicator (DCS)). Function: Flow indication on DCS. Location: H2 injection line. Interlock: —
- PV-3404: Reactor Vent Valve (On/Off Valve) [Setpoint: OPEN —]. Function: EFF-3: Open reactor vent on trip. Location: Reactor vent line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 EFF-3
- EA-3401: In-Line Electric Pre-Heater (Heater) [Setpoint: TRIP —]. Function: EFF-1: Trip Heater on trip. Location: N2 carrier line. Interlock: SEQ-3401 EFF-1
- PSV-3401: Pressure Safety Valve (Relief Valve) [Setpoint: 6 barg]. Function: Overpressure protection. Location: Reactor top. Interlock: —
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-DC-3401A, Interlock: SEQ-3401.
